key_terms.جَنَّاتِ: Gardens (plural of Jannah, referring to Paradise)

ai.seo_question: What does 'Gardens of Delight' refer to in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'Gardens of Delight' signifies the ultimate spiritual and physical reward for the Ahl al-Bayt and their faithful followers, emphasizing the continuity of divine grace from this world to the Hereafter. This designation underscores the concept of 'Baqa' (eternal abode), where the righteous attain proximity to Allah through the intercession of the Imams, reflecting the culmination of their spiritual journey.
